required_concepts: kite has one pair of equal opposite angles
angles in a quadrilateral add up to 360°
acceptable_paraphrases: A kite must have at least one pair of equal opposite angles
Kites cannot have all four angles different
The sum of the angles in any quadrilateral is 360 degrees
critical_errors: Angles are all different and not a kite
Total angle does not add to 360°
misconceptions: A kite must have two pairs of equal angles
The sum of the given angles is correct and forms a kite
All four angles in a kite are different
Kite has one pair of opposite but not necessarily equal sides
grading_notes: Grading should focus on identifying the key concept that a kite must have at least one pair of equal opposite angles. Incorrect statements about the total sum or side lengths should be noted as misconceptions.
